run_split_train_valid_docs: run the script to split a large text file into train and valid sets by document boundaries
run_split_by_lines: run the script with --lines flag to split individual lines instead of documents
run_reservoir_sampling: run the script with -k to sample k random documents using reservoir sampling
review_update_sample: review the update_sample function that implements reservoir sampling for maintaining a random sample of k documents
review_main: review the main function that parses arguments and orchestrates splitting input into sample and remainder output files
